title: File:Rockefeller Center, December 1933.jpg
art: Samuel Herman Gottscho; restored by Michel Vuijlsteke
desc: "New York City views. Rockefeller Center and RCA Building from 515 Madison Ave. In 2004, the Library contracted with Chicago Albumen Works to preserve this deteriorating acetate negative by removing and relaxing the emulsion layer (the pellicle) and producing duplicate negatives and digital files."

title: File:Rockefeller Center Maison Francaise Janniot Sculpture 2019-09-30 18-22.jpg
desc: This sculpture by Alfred Janniot sits above the bronze engraving of the Rockefeller Center's Maison Francaise on Fifth Avenue. It reads "Liberté, Egalité, Fraternité" (Liberty, Equality, Fraternity).
